transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. Um, I guess I'm here because I just... I don't care about anything anymore. 

I used to do things. I had my art classes, and board-game nights. I liked hiking, and I was even thinking about getting back to playing on my soccer team. But now... I just don't care about any of it. I don't want to do any of those things. I just sit in my room all day while everything just kind of slips away.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well, it really became constant around the summer of last year. So... I'd say it has lasted about a year and four months now.
During these past 16 months, have there been any periods where your mood felt significantly worse than how you feel right now, or has it been pretty much the same the whole time?

I think it's been pretty much the same the whole time. Just... constantly bad. Most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It just feels like there’s no future for me beyond the apartment walls. So, yeah, it hasn't really fluctuated much... it's just been that same feeling every day.
Over this past year and four months, have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or how much you've been eating?

Yeah, my appetite is pretty much gone. I usually go most of the day without eating anything. Food just... it tastes like cardboard to me now, so I don't see the point. I've definitely lost weight. My jeans have gotten so loose I actually have to tie a knot in the waistband just to keep them up.
Over these past 16 months, have you experienced any consistent problems with your sleep, such as having trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping way more than usual?

Yeah, my sleep is really bad. I usually lie awake for hours at night. I just... I have to keep checking the door, and I just lie there listening to make sure everything is okay. And then, when I do finally fall asleep, I always wake up way before dawn. I wake up shaking, and I just can't get back to sleep after that. It's like that every night.
You mentioned you feel the need to check the door and listen for sounds; is that something you feel you have to do because you are constantly worried about your safety?

Yeah, I am worried. I know it probably sounds impossible, but... I’m sure the people downstairs, and some of my ex’s friends, have been tracking when I leave the apartment. I know they are because the hallway lights blink right after I even just think about going to the store. So I have to keep checking the door to make sure they aren't out there waiting for me.
Have you ever spoken to anyone else, like a neighbor or a landlord, to confirm if the hallway lights are actually flickering or if they have noticed anything unusual in the building?

No, I haven't asked anyone else about it. I just... I know it sounds impossible, but I'm sure the people downstairs and some of my ex's friends are tracking when I leave. I don't need to ask anyone because I see it happen. The hallway lights blink right after I even just think about going to the store. It's too specific to be a coincidence, so I just keep to myself.
When you are speaking to me or to others, do you ever feel like your thoughts become jumbled, or that you have trouble keeping your sentences organized so that others can understand you?

Yeah, I... I do have trouble with that. People tell me they can't follow what I'm saying. When I try to explain what's been happening, my thoughts just... they jump around. I'll be talking about the divorce papers, and then suddenly I'm thinking about paint colors, or... or the number seven. It just comes out all mixed up, and I can't keep it straight.
During the last 16 months, have there been any periods where you experienced a distinct episode of feeling extremely high, energetic, or irritable, in addition to the low mood you described?

No, I haven't had anything like that. I've never felt really high or full of energy... mostly I just feel really down and drained, like I mentioned before. I don't get those energetic or irritable periods.
